name: roll-final
description: Barrel roll (jump >= 2 m above the deck edge, 360° about the long axis, soft landing) with the pure MPC `mpc` (no pd): the final settings of experiments/reports/barrel-roll, twin, flat preset, 10 seeds; references: pd and the default pure MPC soft landing (objective land) without a manoeuvre. Soft body: node tools/sim/flight.mjs preset=flat controller='mpc:<this controller without name/label>' out=mpc-roll dur=7.
_doc_settings: MPC: horizon 4 s (covers edge -> touchdown ~2.8 s + 1 s on the ground), knots every 0.1 s, linear, 7 wrench modes; hybrid optimizer = CEM 128 samples x 1 iteration at sigma 0.2 (coarse) then 2 iterations at sigma 0.07 (fine) per plan, replan every 2 control steps (40 ms); cold first plan 30 passes; heave exploration x2, roll x0.8. Objective `roll` (src/flight/mpc/objectives/roll.js, every weight spelled out).
